edits.new: approve call with a versionId that does not exist, answered 404

findings.issue: AC11 and TC-E3-030-15 describe asking for or reading a policy version, but there is no single-version read. Only the approve operation takes a versionId.
BR12 now calls the loader and approver reference a 'system user reference'. The disposition only covers its classification, and these are human users.
TC-E3-030-13 wording is garbled: 'P2 LOADED by the same user who loaded it' does not say that the loader is the one calling the approve.
The note names only TC-E3-030-12 and -13 as new in §16. TC-E3-030-14 and -15 were also added and need v8 rows.
